Love this place!!! Great vibes and great cocktails!
Aug 2019 • Friends
Drinking and Healing is the perfect place to grab a drink and enjoy the night. They played good music at the right volume, the place was full but didn’t feel packed and cramped, and the lighting and ambience was perfect. 
The best part was of course the drinks and amazingly talented bartenders!!! Everything we had from their special/house cocktails menu was extremely delicious. The bartenders are not just making drinks and pouring whatever the recipe says inside... they are actually making delicious drinkable art and put so much effort in it! That’s why it tastes so good! I would like to commend our mixologist/bartender “Zoo” for making our drinks. He is very skilled and great at mixing drinks. He even made a special cocktail just for me based on my favorite alcohol and the taste i was looking for. My friend and I will go back one day and I would highly recommend going here!!

Great place to chill with friends and listen to classic hip hop
Jun 2019 • Friends
It’s a tough place to find because it’s on the 2nd floor and no visible signs from the outside. It’s on a corner across the Nhu Lan bakery on Ham Nghi street. However once you find it you will never want to leave. Super chill place with classic hip hop. They have some very interesting drinks. I like the fact they offer you options of sitting in high chairs, a normal table or even a couch without trying to upsell you on bottle service. No pressure here to order right away. Staff is super friendly. 
It’s pricey. Drinks are 200-250k VND and food is 150k or more for really small portions. However, this place has a relaxed atmosphere and the music isn’t too loud so you can actually have a conversation without yelling.

Here, you can recover from life
Jan 2019 • Friends
The name of this bar has become a joke for a place to go after a bad day. Got dumped? Drinking & Healing. Got fired? Drinking & Healing. Got the blues? Drinking and Healing. It seems like, if you have troubles, this is the place to go. 

I’ve never been sad when I walked through their doors. The atmosphere (dark and warm, yet it never feels like it’s crowded) and the music (R&B and old school hip hop) invite you to sit and disappear. You feel at ease here, and it’s easy to let your troubles (if you have any) drop into your drink. 

Speaking of drinks, follow the recommendations of others. They are pricey, but that’s with good reason: the best bartenders in Saigon work here and D&H’s “secret menu” is hands-down better than the one that the waitstaff hands you. My personal favorite is “matcha cocktail”. Give it a try--you’ll thank me. 

A word of warning: the bartenders take time with every drink. They make it right. Good things come to those who wait (especially on busy nights). ;)
